faqs.a:
The board shall make all necessary rules and regulations for managing and discharging
               its duties (not inconsistent with statute or with the provisions of this chapter),
               which it may deem necessary or advisable to carry out the provisions thereof; shall
               hear and decide all applications for relief or pensions under the provisions of this
               chapter, and its action upon such applications shall be final and conclusive; except
               that when, in its opinion, justice demands that said actions should be reconsidered,
               the same may be reversed by the board. A record of said action and all other matters
               coming properly before the board shall be kept and preserved.
(Code 1960, § 19-2(B); Code 1981, § 26-33)
State Law reference—
Rules and regulations under statutory system, C.R.S. § 31-30-605.
